question: Should this Feishu pairing failure be routed to OpenClaw runtime/Feishu plugin triage, or should ClawHub own a new registry/API follow-up?
rationale: The failing command and pending-pairing state are absent from this checkout, so automation cannot choose the owning subsystem without maintainer product and ownership intent.

options.title: Route to runtime or Feishu plugin
options.body: Treat this as an OpenClaw runtime/channel bug and gather pairing logs from both sides before deciding whether ClawHub has any role.

options.title: Create a narrower ClawHub API task
options.body: Use this only if runtime triage proves the pairing flow depends on a missing ClawHub registry, package, or install API.

options.title: Wait for reporter repro detail
options.body: Keep this issue open but request current OpenClaw version, requester/approver steps, WSL/network mode, and both-side logs before routing.

recommendation.title: Route to runtime or Feishu plugin
recommendation.body: Treat this as an OpenClaw runtime/channel bug and gather pairing logs from both sides before deciding whether ClawHub has any role.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-main owner for ClawHub CLI/auth/package boundary decisions shown by the inspected history.
